entities.summary: The Botanischer Garten Karlsruhe is a municipal botanical garden located in Karlsruhe, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. This garden should not be confused with the nearby Botanical Garden of the KIT operated by the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT).
